faction.secret-order.description: A project placeholder neutral faction label.
ability.rank.01.description: Grants and immediately spends a quill to make this faction's highest surviving rank the leader.
ability.rank.02.description: Uses the implemented damage-two rule behavior.
ability.rank.03.description: Inspect two other players and privately learn their identities.
ability.rank.04.description: During an intervention, harm the protected player for one damage or heal one damage and return one revealed token.
ability.rank.05.description: Deal one damage to another player, reveal rank, and hand over the dagger.
ability.rank.06.description: Place a shield on a target and hold a sword as its guardian ward.
ability.rank.07.description: When attacked or chosen as an intervention responder, the original attacker takes one reaction damage.
ability.rank.08.description: Grant a staff and obscure a target's identity markers.
ability.rank.09.description: Grant a fan that prevents intervention.
ability.placeholder.description: Reserved until an evidenced rule implementation is available.
ability.inquisitor.description: Uses the implemented curse-distribution rule behavior.
unit.identity.description: A data-driven placeholder identity. Render its faction and rank as separate localized fields.
board.supply.description: Placeholder zone for unrevealed tokens and resources.
